# COTREX - Colorado Trail Explorer

> > Colorado's official trail mapping and discovery platform providing comprehensive information on hiking, biking, and multi-use trails across Colorado's public lands.

COTREX (Colorado Trail Explorer) is the state's authoritative resource for exploring trails throughout Colorado's national forests, wilderness areas, and public lands. The platform features detailed route information, difficulty ratings, and interactive maps to help outdoor enthusiasts plan adventures across locations like Roosevelt National Forest, Pike National Forest, and Indian Peaks Wilderness.

## Key Topics

- COTREX
- Colorado trail system
- Roosevelt National Forest
- Pike National Forest
- Indian Peaks Wilderness
- Lost Lake
- Buffalo Peaks
- Nederland area trails
- Hiking difficulty ratings (easy, moderate)
- Multi-use trails (hiking, horseback riding, backpacking)
- Featured routes
- Out-and-back trails
- Loop trails
- Lake hikes
- Front Range trails

## Featured Hiking Routes

- [Lost Lake · Featured Route](https://trails.colorado.gov/routes/84): Easy hiking route to Lost Lake near Nederland in Roosevelt National Forest
- [Buffalo Peaks Rich Creek to Tumble Creek Loop · Featured Route](https://trails.colorado.gov/routes/63): Moderate loop hike with Buffalo Peaks views in Pike National Forest
- [Spruce Mountain Loop · Featured Route](https://trails.colorado.gov/routes/142): Scenic loop trail with Front Range and Pikes Peak views at Spruce Mountain
- [Mount Margaret Out & Back · Featured Route](https://trails.colorado.gov/routes/37): Easy multi-use trail through Roosevelt National Forest to Mount Margaret
- [Arapaho Bend Hike · Featured Route](https://trails.colorado.gov/routes/14346): Interpretive loop trail for birdwatching at Rigden Reservoir, Larimer County
